# Schema Weaver Documentation

> Schema Weaver — The First Voice-Native Analytics Workspace for PostgreSQL.

## Pages

- [Introduction](/introduction): Schema Weaver is the first voice-native analytics workspace for PostgreSQL — explore live data, ask Resona AI in plain English, or talk to your database by voice
- [Your Connections](/connector/connections): Manage the PostgreSQL databases your Connector can reach — add them, switch between them, and see which one is currently active
- [Health & Execution Logs](/connector/health): Check whether your Connector is online, see its recent activity, and read the queries Schema Weaver has run through it
- [The Connector](/connector): The Schema Weaver Connector is a small service that runs inside your environment and reaches your PostgreSQL database on your behalf — so your credentials never have to leave it
- [Install & Run](/connector/install): Install the Schema Weaver Connector CLI on your machine, run it as a 24/7 background service, and register it with Schema Weaver
- [Security Architecture](/connector/security-architecture): Schema Weaver's connector security architecture — Local Credential Boundary (LCB), Connector-Enforced Read-Only Execution (CERO), and Zero-Ingress Network Isolation
- [Sharing with Your Team](/connector/sharing): Give teammates access to a Connector and the databases behind it, without sharing credentials, and control who can manage it
- [AI Tools Reference](/sql-editor/ai-assistant-tools): Complete reference for all 55 tools available to Resona AI in the SQL Editor — schema analysis, file management, database migrations, graph analysis, audits, and more
- [Workspace Editing](/sql-editor/ai-assistant-workspace): Resona AI makes targeted, surgical edits to your SQL project files — single-block patches, multi-change file edits, and cross-file refactoring with full preview and rollback
- [Resona AI — SQL Editor](/sql-editor/ai-assistant): An agentic AI assistant built into the SQL Editor — generate DDL, analyze schemas, edit files across your project, run migrations, and reason through your entire schema with 50+ purpose-built tools
- [Resona AI in the ER Diagram](/sql-editor/er-diagram-ai): Analyze tables, schema groups, and your entire schema with Resona AI directly from the ER Diagram — generate SQL, suggest indexes, check normalization, and apply changes instantly
- [Grouping & Schema Clusters](/sql-editor/er-diagram-grouping): Cluster your ER diagram nodes by PostgreSQL schema namespace — resizable group containers, schema color coding, per-group stats, and lock mode
- [Path Analysis](/sql-editor/er-diagram-path-analysis): Instantly find the shortest JOIN path between PostgreSQL tables using BFS and Dijkstra algorithms. Visualize relationship chains in the SW ER Diagram.
- [Visibility & Node Types](/sql-editor/er-diagram-visibility): Control exactly which PostgreSQL object types and which schema namespaces are shown in the ER Diagram — declutter large schemas and focus on what matters
- [ER Diagram](/sql-editor/er-diagram): Visualize your entire PostgreSQL schema as a live, interactive entity-relationship diagram — all object types supported, updates in real time as you write SQL
- [File Manager](/sql-editor/file-manager): Organize your PostgreSQL schemas into cloud projects, folders, and files using the SQL Editor's built-in file manager
- [SQL Editor](/sql-editor): Design and manage PostgreSQL schemas with the SW SQL Editor. Features modular DDL projects, integrated ER diagrams, and real-time schema compilation.
- [Schema Compiler](/sql-editor/schema-compiler): Audit your database quality with the SW Schema Compiler. 20-layer static analysis for PostgreSQL DDL with A-F health grading and auto-repair fixes.
- [Schema Diff](/sql-editor/schema-diff): Compare two versions of a PostgreSQL schema side-by-side with the SQL Editor's built-in diff tool — highlight additions, removals, and modifications
- [Version History](/sql-editor/version-history): Browse and restore every saved snapshot of your SQL files in the Schema Weaver SQL Editor — never lose a working schema state
- [Writing SQL](/sql-editor/writing-sql): Use the SQL Editor's tabs, syntax highlighting, autosave, split view, and fullscreen mode to write PostgreSQL schema definitions efficiently
- [Statistics & Metrics with AI](/data-explorer/dashboard): Generate an executive business dashboard from your PostgreSQL database with AI — KPI cards, multi-section analytics, executive written insights with actionable recommendations, panel operations, and Resona Dashboard AI
- [Exploring Your Data](/data-explorer/exploring-data): The Data Explorer grid — smart column sizing, filtering in the database or your browser, sorting, column statistics, and pagination in the Schema Weaver data explorer
- [Exporting Data](/data-explorer/exporting-data): Export what you see in the Data Explorer to CSV, Google Sheets, Excel, JSON, or SQL — the current grid view, a selection of tables, or an entire schema as a ZIP archive
- [Data Explorer](/data-explorer): The Data Explorer is Schema Weaver's analytics workspace for PostgreSQL — browse live rows in a high-performance grid, ask Resona AI in plain English, talk to your database by voice, and export to CSV, Sheets, Excel, JSON, or SQL
- [Chat Interface](/resona-ai/ai-chat): How to work with Resona in the Data Explorer — asking questions, mentioning tables, attaching files, choosing Flash or Deep, and what comes back
- [Resona Dashboard AI](/resona-ai/dashboard): Resona Dashboard AI is your dedicated live analytics and visualization partner — build executive dashboards, run multi-query investigations, attach files (PDF, CSV, Excel, images), toggle Deep and Flash modes, and modify metrics conversationally
- [Resona AI](/resona-ai): Resona is Schema Weaver's assistant. In the Data Explorer it works your live database in four forms — chat, voice, dashboard, and memory. Also covers the SQL Editor assistant
- [AI Memory](/resona-ai/memory): Resona automatically records what it learns from conversations into persistent memory shared across Chat, Voice, and Dashboard AI — edit directly in place in Settings
- [Resona Voice](/resona-ai/voice): Talk to your PostgreSQL database out loud. Resona Voice is an ambient conversational data analyst that hears your questions, queries your database, and answers back — minimized and present everywhere across your table grid, dashboard, and chat
- [Workspace & Projects](/resona-ai/workspace): Organise your Resona AI analyses into projects, keep generated reports in one place, and search your full artifact history
- [Team Collaboration](/team-collaboration): Manage teams, invite colleagues, share local connectors without passing around passwords, distribute AI projects, and browse shared databases — from Settings → Collaboration
- [Plans and Credits](/pricing): Schema Weaver pricing — Free, Pro, and Team plans, what AI credits cover, how seats work on Team, and tracking credit usage in Settings
